activities.name: Process
activities.description: Process a plan through a conduit.

coverage.notes: Processes the selected ItemSignal grid using a clone of incoming Plan. Clone Adapter/Activity are overwritten from ForEachAdapter/ForEachActivity; helper routing reads are attributed back to those sources. No arbitrary downstream adapter inventory. Serial helper Plan can later be rebound to item data, so only proven pre-rebinding incoming fields are attributed.

properties.description: Provide the activity copied into the per-item dispatch plan.

evidence.trace: Direct inherited clone.ForEachActivity is assigned to clone.Activity; this assignment read has no resolver Default.
evidence.condition: Process after grid selection and cloning succeed.

properties.description: Resolve the per-item activity after forwarding it into the cloned Activity field.

evidence.trace: Conduit lines 97-100 clone the incoming plan and set Activity from ForEachActivity. The helper resolves that Activity with literal -Default "Read"; this fallback applies to the forwarded value, not to original Plan.Activity.
evidence.condition: Process helper entry after the Activity field has been populated from ForEachActivity.

properties.description: Choose the mapped adapter for each grid item.

evidence.trace: The cloned ForEachAdapter is copied into clone.Adapter; the process helper reads Adapter for routing. Original Plan.Adapter is overwritten and not inventoried.
evidence.condition: Process after grid selection and cloning succeed.

properties.description: Select the ItemSignal grid to process.

evidence.trace: Incoming ForEachPath supplies the ItemSignal resolver path.
evidence.condition: Process before selecting the source grid.

properties.description: Name the process signal and iteration tracing.

evidence.trace: Name is inherited by the clone. Entry Name and pre-rebinding trace Name originate in incoming Plan; after local plan is replaced with an item result, subsequent names are item-owned and excluded.
evidence.condition: Process helper entry and tracing before any local plan rebinding.

properties.description: Preserve the parent-phase reference while cloning.

evidence.trace: Conduit calls Resolve-ClonePlan on original Plan at line 97; helper reads Plan and Phase before temporarily removing/restoring them.
evidence.condition: Process before constructing the dispatch clone.

properties.description: Preserve the parent-plan reference while cloning.

evidence.trace: Conduit calls Resolve-ClonePlan on original Plan at line 97; helper reads Plan and Phase before temporarily removing/restoring them.
evidence.condition: Process before constructing the dispatch clone.

properties.description: Choose the serial versus parallel conduit branch.

evidence.trace: The helper receives the clone and resolves inherited SupportParallelism with literal -Default $false. Pool receives Plan but has no active property reads.

coverage.notes: Source-supported Graph activity belongs to ConduitCondenser. It passes original Plan into the specific SignalGraph helper; this does not make GraphCondenser an activity owner.

properties.description: Name the graph-plan signal and diagnostic messages.

evidence.trace: Direct Plan.Name is used for graph-plan identity and diagnostic branching.

properties.description: Select the identifier field in each source-array item.

evidence.trace: Conduit line 133 forwards original Plan. The helper resolves NamePath with literal -Default "Name" and uses it against each ItemSignal-derived item.
evidence.condition: Graph helper after source array resolution succeeds.

properties.description: Select the ItemSignal array and derive the graph name from the final path segment.

evidence.trace: Original Path is resolved, split for naming, and used against ItemSignal; the selected objects are not Plan children.
evidence.condition: Graph branch before the graph helper.
